forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {濯|すす}いでいませんでした

definitions.explanation: To wash something with clean water to remove soap, dirt, or impurities.
To rinse one's mouth or throat with liquid.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{濯|すす}いで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please rinse out the detergent thoroughly.
I rinsed my mouth with water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{濯|すす}いで⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧。
examples.english: Rinse the rice before cooking it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{濯|すす}ぐ。

examples.english: After washing my hands with soap, I rinsed them with water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{濯|すす}ぐ⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a habit of rinsing my mouth after eating.
I rinse my mouth after brushing my teeth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{汚名|おめい}→汚名：13265_omei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{濯|すす}ぐ⟦ために→ために：28332_tameni⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}した→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I worked hard to clear my name.
examples.notes: Figurative use: ⟦{汚名|おめい}→汚名：13265_omei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{濯|すす}ぐ means to clear one's reputation.

examples.english: I gargled my throat with medicine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ために→ために：28332_tameni⟧、⟦{帰宅|きたく}したら→帰宅する：22169_kitakusuru⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{濯|すす}ぐ⟦ようにしている→ようにする：10987_younisuru⟧。
examples.english: To prevent colds, I make sure to gargle when I get home.

notes:
{濯|すす}ぐ is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) specifically for rinsing with water.

ASPECT (ている):
{濯|すす}いでいる indicates rinsing is in progress.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [thing]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{濯|すす}ぐ — to rinse [thing]
- [water]⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{濯|すす}ぐ — to rinse with [water]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{濯|すす}ぐ (rinse laundry)
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{濯|すす}ぐ (rinse mouth)
- ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{濯|すす}ぐ (rinse rice)
- ⟦{汚名|おめい}→汚名：13265_omei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{濯|すす}ぐ (clear one's name - figurative)

WASHING PROCESS:
In laundry: ⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧ (wash) → {濯|すす}ぐ (rinse) → ⟦{絞|しぼ}る→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧ (wring) → ⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧ (hang to dry)

OFTEN IN HIRAGANA:
This verb is frequently written as すすぐ due to the kanji's rarity.

RELATED:
- ⟦うがい→うがい：01853_ugai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to gargle - more common for gargling)
